objective: Characterize practical relative fidelity and computational-cost evidence for purpose-aware reduced SWAP baselines without application acceptance.

development.note: Previously exposed P2 histories are intentionally development evidence only.

blind_validation.rule: A fresh production-like forcing panel must be frozen before new candidate response; P3 blind response may not be imported opportunistically.

reference: Qualified high-resolution Richards authority from ROM-PURPOSE P2 (R2048_T32 target; R512_T32 numerical comparator).

performance: CPU ratio versus same-host R16 screen

regime_rules.STRUCTURALLY_UNRELIABLE: candidate not numerically qualified or water-ledger gate fails
regime_rules.EVENT_SENSITIVE: GW candidate has any sign, reversal-sequence or reversal-timing mismatch
regime_rules.TIMING_SENSITIVE: SM candidate has non-zero storage-extremum timing error while remaining numerically qualified
regime_rules.ROBUST: candidate is numerically qualified, has no discrete-event/timing mismatch, and its aligned placement is componentwise no worse than U4 on the frozen purpose vector
regime_rules.SMALL_BIAS: reserved for later absolute-error characterization; not assigned from ungoverned thresholds in P1
regime_rules.GROUNDWATER_SENSITIVE: reserved for fresh practical groundwater panel where errors covary with water-table regime

targeted_repair_rule: No repair in P1 evidence screen. A repair work unit may open only after a fresh practical development panel identifies one dominant attributed defect.

performance_method.use: state-count implementation-cost prior only, reported separately from hydrological fidelity

meta_swap.rule: No direct MetaSWAP result unless executable/data provenance is reproducible and semantically comparable.

stop_rules: Do not use P3 candidate response to tune P1 baselines.
Do not collapse hydrological fidelity and cost to one scalar.
Do not make production/application acceptance claims.
Do not open P-ROM-ET before GW and SM fresh practical characterization.
